judgment.notes: Defines coordinate derivatives only where they exist, standard Euclidean inner products/norms, Frobenius square and coordinate-product Lebesgue measure, matching the fixed problem. Smoothness and integrability conventions are explicit; no regularity or conservation property is granted by the definition. Coordinate/component indices have their stated finite-dimensional scopes.

The componentwise finite sum of second spatial derivatives has the correct vector codomain and original sign convention. H002 is the explicit existence guard, not a property hidden in the definition; R001 and R005, which use this operator, both list H002 directly. No selected scalar a or its regularity is built into Δ_xu.

e is uniquely defined as the scalar sum of the squared Euclidean time derivative norm and squared spatial column norms on positive times, without a factor 1/2. The finite index range and derivative existence guard H002 are explicit. Every inference using the density lists H002; integrability and smoothness remain assertions to prove, not definitional gifts.

E is the actual finite spatial Lebesgue integral, introduced only after the integrability assertion N002; it is not a formal antiderivative or an assumed differentiable object. N002's producer does not use E, so the guard is noncircular. Both R003 and R005 list N002 and H002 directly. Two-sided differentiation is restricted to the open interval (0,∞); local extensions add no time-zero assertion.

Read the full successful native signature and pinned theorem. The statement retains precisely the real normed additive-group/space codomain, arbitrary measurable domain and measure, countably generated filter, eventual a.e. strong measurability, eventual a.e. domination, integrable real bound and a.e. pointwise filter limit. It concludes convergence of the Bochner integrals, not a pointwise or uniform conclusion. No completeness premise is in the signature and none is silently required in the restatement. Declaration/module/path and recorded source hash agree between candidate and native evidence at commit 905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c, Lean 4.32.2.
